exposure: time interval from antenatal corticosteroid administration to delivery
gestational age at antenatal corticosteroid administration
cohort: 1248 singleton neonates exposed to 1 or 2 doses of antenatal corticosteroids in the late preterm period (34+0 to 36+6 weeks' gestation)
finding: Late preterm birth occurring <2 days after antenatal corticosteroid administration is associated with an increased risk for transient tachypnea of the newborn, respiratory distress syndrome, and hypoglycemia compared with birth 2 to 7 days after administration.
